_about: Things that expire or need a periodic review. A weekly GitHub Actions run fails (and GitHub emails you) when one is due within warn_days, and the app shows a banner. After dealing with an item, move its due date on.

items.action: Create a new key at connect.garmin.com/app/settings/personalApiToken, replace GARMIN_PERSONAL_API_KEY in Render's Environment settings, then set this date to the new key's expiry.
Check Anthropic's models page for a deprecation notice or a newer model. Update the model in backend/vision.py and backend/summary.py if needed, run the tests, then move this date on six months.
requirements.txt pins anthropic below 1.0. Check whether 0.x still receives updates; if not, plan the upgrade (it changes some call signatures). Move this date on six months.
